The main finding is that only 19% of Americans were following election news very closely, with an additional 32% following it fairly closely, resulting in a total of 50% paying attention. pages.ocr_text: Methodology The analysis in this report is based on telephone interviews conducted April 25-May 1, 2018 among a national sample of 1,503 adults, 18 years of age or older, living in all 50 U.S. states and the District of Columbia (376 respondents were interviewed on a landline telephone, and 1,127 were interviewed on a cell phone, including 740 who had no landline telephone). The survey was conducted by interviewers under the direction of Abt Associates.
